title: ns2jb by kurumuz
subtitle: NS2K · original kurumuz bootstrap · 5 arguments · port 39380.
notes: First setup enters the source into the selected empty slot and saves NS2K separately from IZMYSH. After a restart, Launch loads NS2K into slot 0 and enters RUN, REMOVE and START with 5 arguments.
This upstream does not provide a separate graphical console menu.
This mode does not provide a Wi-Fi driver installer or NRO loader.
Upstream removes temporary objects prefixed NS2_GAP from SmileBASIC save/tmp during startup.
